en: Sepia-toned coastal view showing a calm bay framed by rugged hills or small mountains. In the foreground there is a narrow road curving along the shoreline, bordered by tall slender cypress trees and other vegetation. An islet or narrow peninsula extends into the water on the right. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. There is faint handwritten text at the bottom and a printed website watermark "www.ella.org.gr" over the image.
